1. Create your account
App: Sign up & onboarding
Path: /login
Sign up with personal email (free) or verify school email for Premium. Roles: Personal, Student, Educator, Admin.

Name: Process
Text Area 1:
2. Join or create a team
App: Welcome onboarding · Settings → Teams
Path: /settings?tab=workspace
Start a team or request to join. Team leads approve join requests in chat.

Name: Process
Text Area 1:
3. Run work on the board
App: Dashboard
Path: /
Plan sprints: tasks, assignees, categories, due dates, with team chat tied to your group.

Name: Process
Text Area 1:
4. Prove who did what
App: Activity log · Project Stats
Path: /analytics
Logs, stats, and artifacts verify contributions for fair assessments.

Name: Process
Text Area 1:
5. Store work & track impact
App: My Assets · Impact
Path: /assets/impact
My Assets stores files/links. Impact Log records marketplace & Hustle events with verification IDs.

Name: Process
Text Area 1:
6. Earn and trade on campus
App: Hustle · Resources
Path: /hustle
Post/accept Hustle gigs with escrow credits. Buy/sell on Resources with a traceable credit trail.

Name: Process
Text Area 1:
7. Stay in sync with people
App: Feed · Teammates
Path: /network
Journey feed, roster/network, in-app notifications, and team chat on the board.

Name: Process
Text Area 1:
8. Switch teams in one tap
App: Settings → Teams
Path: /settings?tab=workspace
Set active team, switch back, or request new — boards stay saved.
